Learning Experience Designer, Skillharbor Business
Skillharbor
Remote (US)
Full-time

About Skillharbor

Skillharbor is an online learning marketplace and platform with a large catalog of courses taught by expert instructors. Individuals use Skillharbor to learn new skills, and organizations use Skillharbor Business to provide on-demand learning to their employees.

About the team

The Learning Design team on Skillharbor Business builds learning programs that companies roll out to their employees: structured learning paths, cohort-based programs, and onboarding experiences that combine catalog courses with original content. Our customers' learning and development teams count on us to help their people build skills that matter on the job. We design for busy adult learners who have twenty minutes between meetings.

About the role

As a Learning Experience Designer, you'll design and build learning paths and short-form original content for workplace learners. You'll work closely with learning strategists, content producers, product managers, and customer L&D teams. You'll take a business need, like "our new managers struggle with giving feedback," and turn it into a learning experience people actually complete and use.

What you'll do

- Design end-to-end learning paths that combine existing courses with new practice activities, scenarios, and knowledge checks.
- Write storyboards and scripts for short interactive lessons and videos.
- Design scenario-based practice and assessments that mirror real work situations, with meaningful feedback for each choice.
- Run user testing with learners and iterate based on what you observe.
- Partner with learning strategists to define objectives and success measures, and review completion and engagement data after launch.
- Create facilitator guides and job aids for live and blended programs.
- Help maintain our design standards, templates, and accessibility guidelines.

What we're looking for

- 3+ years designing learning experiences for K-12, higher education, or adult learners.
- A strong grasp of adult learning principles and evidence-based design (for example, retrieval practice, spaced learning, worked examples).
- Experience writing storyboards, scripts, and assessments.
- Experience building blended or online learning in an LMS or authoring tool.
- Experience leading workshops or training sessions for adults.
- Clear, concise writing and a habit of testing your assumptions with real learners.
- Comfort working async with a distributed team.

Nice to have

- Corporate learning and development experience, or experience training teachers or other professionals.
- Familiarity with Articulate Rise/Storyline, Figma, or similar tools.
- Experience with learning analytics or survey design.
- Bilingual in English and Spanish or another language.

Compensation

The base pay range for this role across the US is $100,000 to $130,000. Your final base pay depends on job-related skills, experience, and location. This role is eligible for equity and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement savings, paid parental leave, an annual learning budget, and a Skillharbor Business account for you and your family.

Location and setup

This is a remote role open to candidates anywhere in the United States. The team is spread across US time zones, with core collaboration hours of 10am–2pm Pacific. Travel is minimal: one in-person team gathering per year.

Work authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We support visa sponsorship and transfers for this role where needed.

How to apply

Please include a portfolio or two or three work samples (storyboards, a course you built, a training you designed). We care more about how you think about learners than about polished visuals.
